trainer/30460.htm.text: Master Cardien: There is meaning in every action, even that of leaves shaken by the wind. There is no better skill than to be able to distinguish truth from falsehood. Do you wish to learn?

trainer/30460-noteach.htm.text: Master Cardien: There are laws even in teaching! The fighters guild of Dion does not teach its skills to just anyone. You must find a guild that suits you.

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30460-01.html.text: Master Cardien: The future seems very dark... The blood-red sky fades to darker shadows... Blood will soak the earth and run in rivers... The time of the 'Chaotic Chronicle' draws nigh... (Quest for Elven characters level 37 and above.)

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30460-05.html.text: Master Cardien: The hierarch awaits your return. As we speak the Mother Tree is dying. You must quickly return to the Elven Forest.

Q00218_TestimonyOfLife/30460-06.html.text: Master Cardien: At this moment the Mother Tree is dying. Please find the Water of Life and give us hope!

More than any other time in history, we must now truly respect nature, love life and care for our people…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
